title: How One Hard Phone Call a Day Builds a Godly Man’s Courage
caption:
Courage rarely shows up as a feeling. It shows up as a phone call you make while your stomach is tight.

One hard call a day. Thirty days. See who you become.

Save this and make your first call before lunch.

#faith #godlyman #courage #discipline #christianmen
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
